reflection.comment: picocli-codegen only scans fields of @Command-annotated classes, so the @Spec field on this IVersionProvider is not registered automatically. picocli injects it via reflection in CommandLine's constructor, so without this every invocation of the native binary fails.

resources.comment: picocli wraps usage text with BreakIterator.getLineInstance(), which loads its data from java.base as a resource bundle. Without this, rendering the help text fails with 'Can't load sun/text/resources/LineBreakIteratorData'.
